purpose: Teach: トレーダー/地蔵/グランプリ/怪獣/三昧/言うまでもなく/このごろ/スキン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお客様にトレーダーの方がいるの
lines.en: Sho, one of my customers is a trader, you know.
lines.style: Warm, almost musing. Casual opening. Speaking more to herself than at him, but including him naturally in the thought. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お地蔵さん、ぼく、見てきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to see the jizo statue!
lines.style: Quick, bright attack. Bouncing with small-boy excitement but not shouting. Words tumble out. Eager to share what he's discovered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと映画のグランプリ、見に行ったの?
lines.en: Sho, did you go see the film festival with your dad?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, leaning in slightly. Warm curiosity — noticing something he's mentioned and asking to hear more. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、怪獣映画大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love monster movies!
lines.style: Earnest declaration. Not performing, just stating fact with the seriousness only a six-year-old can manage. Clear, direct, no irony.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夏休みは読書三昧で過ごしてね
lines.en: Sho, spend your summer break reading as much as you want, okay?
lines.style: Soft suggestion, not a command. A small gift wrapped in gentleness. Trailing slightly, like she's handing him permission.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが言うまでもなく尊敬する人だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's someone I respect without him even having to say it.
lines.style: Quiet, serious. A child expressing something true and careful. Slight pause before 'respect'—he's choosing the word deliberately. Direct eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、このごろ寒くなってきたわね
lines.en: Sho, it's getting cold these days, isn't it?
lines.style: Reflective shift. Noticing the season change. Gentle, almost to herself, but spoken toward him. A moment of shared awareness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくもお肌のスキンケアした方がいい?
lines.en: Mei-sis, should I be taking care of my skin too?
lines.style: Curious, hesitant opening. A child asking a question that surprises himself. Seeking reassurance and guidance. Close, intimate — like he's confiding something that matters.
